data.name: Dough of the Dead
data.detailed_description:
About the Game

The world is ending, but the hunger hasn't. 

Dough of the Dead is a high octane, PSX inspired driving roguelite where you are the apocalypse's most essential worker: a pizza delivery driver. Speed through infested streets, smash through undead hordes, and make sure those pies arrive piping hot.

The undead are fast, but you are faster. Drift around corners, upgrade your ride, and paint the town red, one pepperoni slice at a time. High risk means high tips, and in this economy, you’re going to need every dime to survive the night.

 Key Features

  • Retro 32-Bit Aesthetics: Authentic PSX style visuals with crunchy pixel art, low-poly models

  • Deadly Deliveries: Navigate through procedurally chaotic waves. Drop off the pizzas, collect your cash, and get out before the horde swarms you.

  • Customization: 20+ Tactical Upgrades: From spiked bumpers and reinforced roll cages to engine turbos and reinforced tires.

    • 5 Unique Unlockable Vehicles: Trade your starter clunker for heavy duty armored trucks or agile drift machines.

  • Diverse, Changing Biomes: No two shifts are the same. Battle your way through three distinct, atmospheric territories:

    • The City: Tight alleyways, abandoned roadblocks, and vertical neon-lit hazards.

    • The Suburbs: Fenced-in backyards and suburban streets

    • The Country: Open dirt roads, heavy off-road navigation

  • Dynamic Surface Physics: Feel the difference between burning rubber on city asphalt versus sliding through the mud and grass of the countryside, complete with reactive tire particle effects.

  • Heavy Synthesizer Soundtrack: Blast through the apocalypse with an original, pulse-pounding synthwave soundtrack.

Can You Survive the Night Shift?

Clock in, start your engine, and remember: The zombies bite, but a cold pizza is the real crime. Add Dough of the Dead to your wishlist today!

data.short_description: Dough of the Dead is a driving, post apocalyptic roguelite where you smash and deliver your way through a zombie apocalypse. Speed through infested streets to ensure your pizzas arrive on time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Dual-Core Intel or AMD processor (2.0 GHz or faster)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD 520 / NVIDIA GeForce GT 710 or better (DirectX 12 / Vulkan 1.1 support)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04+ or SteamOS 3.0+
  • Processor: Dual-Core Intel or AMD processor (2.0 GHz or faster)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Graphics or better (Vulkan 1.1 / OpenGL 3.3 support)
  • Storage: 4 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game includes violence against zombies.
